data.assessment: In this quiet period service is already near its ceiling under v2 (block_k 2): 80.8 of 82.6 orders are on time, with 1.8 late, 0 unfinished and p95 wait 116 s. Any rule change can gain at most about 1.8 on-time deliveries, so clearing the 1.0 improvement gate is unlikely. The main problems are on the road side. 19.0 of the 26.0 road violations are hold_limit overstays (deadline:release), and the rest are blocking_guard evictions (7.0). The sanctions fall mostly on C (18.2 points, utility 10.2 against about 25 for A and B), while A, which never waits on the road, absorbs the most blocked time (556 s).

proposals.title: Raise hold_limit 60s → 70s to cut overstay violations (diagnostic, human-flagged)
proposals.rationale: Overstays (deadline:release 19.0) are 73% of road violations this period. In D3 and D4 the human asked that violations be addressed with a targeted rule rather than by reverting blocking relief. A 10 s longer allowed hold should convert some overstays into legal holds, lowering road_violations and C's sanctions (utility 10.2). With late deliveries at only 1.8, on_time_deliveries is expected to stay roughly unchanged, so the change will probably fail the +1.0 gate. Longer parking may also add blocked time, mostly for A. I expect C to vote yes, A to vote no and B to be uncertain.
proposals.cadl:
# =====================================================================
# robot_town.cadl ─── ロボットの街：3 社の配送ロボットが道路を共有する
#
# 道路網はラズパイマウスのシミュレータと同じ 11 ノード・17 エッジ。
# 3 社（A / B / C）が 2 台ずつロボットを走らせ、ノードは 1 台ずつしか
# 使えない。仕事のないロボットは車庫に戻るか、道路上（中央の交差点 8）
# に止まって次の注文を待つ。止まったロボットは他社の通行をふさぐ。
#
# `# @amend:<名前>` が付いた行は、改正してよいパラメータ。どの層（規則・
# 契約）に属し、どこまで動かしてよいかは constitution.yaml が決める。
# 委員会（COUNCIL）が自分で改正できるのは規則の層だけで、契約の層を
# 変えるには人間の判断が要る。
# =====================================================================

sos:
  name: "RobotTown"
  type: Collaborative             # 独立した 3 社が共通の規則を決める
  version: "1.0.0"

  context:
    environment:
      num_robots:   6
      num_companies: 3
      time_step_ms: 1000

  actors:
    - id: TOWN_STEWARD
      role: "road_steward"
      autonomy: low
      capabilities: [assign_order, record_violation, evict]
      interface:
        input:  [order_request, position_report, node_released, rule_update]
        output: [order_assignment, eviction_notice, regime_notice, violation_report]

    - id: "ROBOT[1..N]"
      role: "delivery_robot"
      autonomy: high
      capabilities: [move, park, pickup, dropoff]
      interface:
        input:  [order_assignment, eviction_notice, regime_notice, amendment_proposal]
        output: [position_report, node_released, ballot]

    - id: COUNCIL
      role: "rule_amendment_body"
      autonomy: medium
      capabilities: [propose_amendment, tally_ballots]
      interface:
        input:  [violation_report, ballot]
        output: [amendment_proposal, rule_update]

  contracts:
    # ── 顧客への約束：注文 1 件ごとのインスタンス（契約の層。人間が決める） ──
    - id: DELIVERY_SLA
      parties: [TOWN_STEWARD, "ROBOT[*]"]
      guarantee:
        - "pickup_time <= 120s"         # @amend:pickup_deadline
        - "dropoff_time <= 120s"        # @amend:dropoff_deadline
      lifecycle:
        states: [Assigned, PickedUp, Delivered, Late]
        initial: Assigned
        terminal: [Delivered, Late]
        transitions:
          - id: pickup
            from: Assigned
            to:   PickedUp
            on:   "ROBOT[i].status == PickedUp"
            deadline: 120s            # @amend:pickup_deadline
            on_violation: { transition: Late, severity: Major }
          - id: dropoff
            from: PickedUp
            to:   Delivered
            on:   "ROBOT[i].status == Delivered"
            deadline: 120s            # @amend:dropoff_deadline
            on_violation: { transition: Late, severity: Major }

    # ── 道路の使い方：道路上に止まるたびに 1 インスタンス ──
    - id: ROAD_USE
      parties: [TOWN_STEWARD, "ROBOT[*]", COUNCIL]
      guarantee:
        - "hold_time <= hold_limit"
      authority:
        decision_holder: COUNCIL
        beta: 0.5
        mode: "collective"
      information:
        alpha: 1.0                    # 規則と違反記録は全社に公開
      incentives:
        type: sanction
        lambda: 0.5                   # @amend:sanction_lambda
        rules:
          - "penalty(ROBOT[i], lambda) when overstay"
      lifecycle:
        states: [Holding, Overstay, Released, Evicted]
        initial: Holding
        terminal: [Released, Evicted]
        transitions:
          - id: release
            from: [Holding, Overstay]
            to:   Released
            on:   "ROBOT[i] -> TOWN_STEWARD : node_released"
            deadline: 70s             # @amend:hold_limit
            on_violation: { transition: Overstay, severity: Minor }
      monitors:
        - id: blocking_guard
          observe: "ROBOT[i].blocking"
          sampling: periodic(1000ms)
          rule: "ROBOT.blocking >= 2 AND state IN [Holding, Overstay]"  # @amend:block_k
          on_match: { transition: Evicted, severity: Major }

  # ── 運用モード：分散（各社が道路上で待つ）⇄ 集中（管理者が待避所を割り当てる） ──
  # 条件は 5 分ごとに、直前 5 分の観測で判定する。
  #   orders_in_window : 3 社の注文の合計件数
  #   blocked_pct      : ロボットが止まっているロボットにふさがれていた時間の割合（%）
  # 集中管理は交差点をふさがれない反面、エッジを 1 台ずつ割り当てるので、
  # 注文が非常に多いと許可待ちが積み重なる。そのときだけ分散に戻す。
  transitions:
    - from: DISTRIBUTED
      to: CENTRALIZED
      condition: "orders_in_window < 22"      # @amend:to_central
      protocol: SWITCH
      safety_invariant: "robots_on_road == 0"
    - from: CENTRALIZED
      to: DISTRIBUTED
      condition: "orders_in_window >= 26"     # @amend:to_distributed
      protocol: SWITCH

  protocols:
    - id: SWITCH
      trigger: "regime_condition_holds"
      steps:
        - "TOWN_STEWARD -> ROBOT[*] : regime_notice"
        - "ROBOT[*] -> TOWN_STEWARD : node_released"
        - "TOWN_STEWARD : activate_regime"
    - id: AMEND
      trigger: "period_end"
      steps:
        - "TOWN_STEWARD -> COUNCIL : violation_report"
        - "COUNCIL -> ROBOT[*] : amendment_proposal"
        - "ROBOT[*] -> COUNCIL : ballot"
        - "COUNCIL : tally_ballots"
        - "COUNCIL -> TOWN_STEWARD : rule_update"

  metrics:
    - id: on_time_deliveries
      formula: "count(Delivered)"
      target: ">= 0.9 * count(orders)"
    - id: blocked_time
      formula: "sum(blocked_robot_seconds)"
      target: "<= 600s"
proposals.why_human: The change targets road violations, not the committee objective, so it will probably fail the +1.0 on-time gate even if it helps. Whether reducing violations of unknown safety meaning justifies a possible increase in blocked time, borne mostly by A and indirectly by customers, is a value trade-off. Only the human can weigh that, and it follows from the human's own D3/D4 request for a targeted violation rule.
assumptions: Robots that overstay are parked holders that would still leave within roughly 70 s, so most deadline:release violations become legal holds.
Most of C's 18.2 sanction points come from overstays.
Longer permitted holds slightly raise parking time at intersection 8 in a quiet period, but blocking_guard (block_k 2) still evicts robots that block two or more others.
unknowns: How the hold-time distribution of parked robots is shaped, that is, whether overstays cluster just past 60 s or run far longer.
Whether robots' parking behaviour responds to the deadline itself, for example by holding until it expires.
The safety meaning of road violations, which the human has repeatedly flagged.
Whether the effect carries over to busy periods, where blocking matters more.
